How to Configure the ACQUITY UPLC System

WKB12345 Last Modified: March 15, 2026

Environment

  • ACQUITY UPLC System
  • Empower Software
  • ACQUITY UPLC H-Class

Summary

This article describes how to configure the ACQUITY UPLC system for optimal performance. The configuration process includes setting up the column manager, sample manager, and binary solvent manager components.

Solution

Follow these steps to configure your ACQUITY UPLC system:

  1. Open Empower software and navigate to the System Configuration panel.
  2. Select the ACQUITY UPLC system from the list of available instruments.
  3. Configure the column manager settings according to your separation requirements.
  4. Set the sample manager injection parameters.
  5. Verify the binary solvent manager flow rates.

Additional Information

For more details about ACQUITY UPLC system configuration, refer to the system operator's guide. Contact Waters Technical Support if you need further assistance.
